items.title: Ran Blake interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, July 16, 2021
items.q: And thank you Milt though, for making this possible, even though he would feel nauseous if he heard me play.

ctx.x: Yes and it’s interesting to know that I think that Milt’s musical tastes, he was very passionate about music but if we were, if the three of us were in a room talking about — and Charlie Parker’s name came up, he would go [growls] oh, na, na. His tastes were in the swing world but he had, thankfully he sort of let me go with the project before he passed away and so here I am with you.
And thank you Milt though, for making this possible, even though he would feel nauseous if he heard me play.
Well I don’t know, that’s a strong word.
